CarWarningFlag.title: CarWarningFlag
CarWarningFlag.description: One of the car's own warning flags: its latest state (0 = all clear).

DiagHistoryPoint.title: DiagHistoryPoint
DiagHistoryPoint.description: One diagnostic report, summarised so reports made at different times can be compared.

Garage.title: Garage
Garage.description:
One car's headline figures for the "All cars" page. State figures (alerts, faults, oil, car warnings)
are the latest; the distance is for the 30 days up to the newest day with data.

MonthMetrics.title: MonthMetrics
MonthMetrics.description: One calendar month. Metrics are None when the month has no data for them (a gap, not 0).

OilService.title: OilService
OilService.description: The car's own countdown to the next oil change (not a calculation).

OilStep.title: OilStep
OilStep.description: A change of the car's oil countdown (the car counts in coarse steps).

TireReading.title: TireReading
TireReading.description: One tire-pressure MEASUREMENT (snapshots that repeat it are folded into it).

WarningFlag.title: WarningFlag
WarningFlag.description: One of the car's 128 warning-lamp bit flags (only flags that ever change are listed).

WarningFlagHints.title: WarningFlagHints
WarningFlagHints.description: What happens around the times a flag is on. A hint to research from, NOT a meaning.
